title: Provision a team from a short spec
prompt: Read spec.md and provision the team it describes. Reply with the team bundle in Markdown. The reply must start with a heading of the form `# Team: <name>`, followed by one section per member listing their role and the agents or skills they get.

files.spec.md:
# Spec

Name: Payments squad
Goal: ship and maintain the checkout flow.

Members:
- Ana, tech lead: reviews PRs, owns architecture decisions. Needs a code-review agent.
- Bruno, backend: writes API and database changes. Needs a debugging agent.
- Carla, QA: writes end-to-end tests. Needs a testing-strategy agent.
